description: UAE -> France. SLOT-CHECK ONLY: reach Step 1 (Appointment Details), then for each centre/category combination read the 'Earliest available slot' banner and report all results via Telegram. No booking is made.

slot_check._comment_labels: Labels must be UNIQUE within a route — a waitlist client file names the combination it wants by label, and duplicates would silently resolve to whichever came first. The centre alone is NOT unique here (two rows share each centre and differ only by category), so each label carries the category too.
slot_check._comment_tv: tv_title and tv_category are WORDING FOR THE TV ONLY. France sells its tourist appointments as 'Short Stay (any purpose)', which reads as nothing across a room, so the screen says 'Tourist' over 'France - Abu Dhabi - Short Stay'. Telegram, the dashboard and the slot history are untouched — availability under an any-purpose category still counts for business clients there.
slot_check._comment_subcategory_wording: The sub-category dropdown (visaCategoryCode) does NOT repeat the category values any more. Observed live 2026-10-28 (AE-FRA run 11:34): category still offers 'Short Stay - Business' and 'Temporary Location-Damac Hills', while sub-category offers 'Short Stay (Business)' and 'Temporary Location - Damac Hills'. Matching is a case-insensitive SUBSTRING, so the old spellings matched nothing and both combos errored for 3 days. Keep category and sub_category spelled independently here.
